description: Source code implementing a file decryption and integrity verification module for Android's Forward Lock feature, including session management, AES-CTR decryption, and HMAC-based integrity checks.

classes.name: FwdLockFile_Session
classes.description: Structure holding per-file session state, including cryptographic context, file position, and metadata.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_AcquireSession
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new session for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_FindSession
methods.description: Finds an existing session associated with a file descriptor.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_ReleaseSession
methods.description: Releases and frees resources associated with a session.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_DeriveKeys
methods.description: Derives encryption and signing keys from the encrypted session key.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CalculateCounter
methods.description: Calculates the AES-CTR counter block based on nonce and block index.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_DecryptByte
methods.description: Decrypts a single byte using AES-CTR mode.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_attach
methods.description: Initializes a session by reading header and key data from the file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_read
methods.description: Reads and decrypts data from the file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_lseek
methods.description: Adjusts the file position within the encrypted file.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_detach
methods.description: Terminates a session and frees resources.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_close
methods.description: Closes the file and releases session resources.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckDataIntegrity
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of the data using HMAC.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckHeaderIntegrity
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of the header using HMAC.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_CheckIntegrity
methods.description: Checks both header and data integrity.

methods.name: FwdLockFile_GetContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type string of the file.
